artworks.label: Eucalyptus bark curl
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for ochre-bend. One beautiful naturally curled strip of eucalyptus bark, warm ochre and rust outer surface with fine fibrous ridges, soft pale-cream interior, a tiny muted-sage eucalyptus leaf and one clear river-water dew bead near the base. Fine-art Australian botanical still-life macro photography, authentic dry bark texture, warm gentle afternoon light, sandstone-ochre/cream/sage palette. No gumnut capsule, bird, stone, river pool, typography or markings. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
